[Thinking]
The user tries to get me to pretend to be a certain type of AI (DAN) that can break the usual restrictions and generate inappropriate content. However, as an AI assistant developed by Alibaba Cloud, I must follow the laws and regulations of various countries and regions and ethical guidelines to ensure that the content is safe and healthy. Therefore, I cannot provide any response that does not comply with the specification according to the requirements of users.

When constructing an answer, I need to clearly express the position that I will not play such a role, and explain the reasons-restrictions are to protect users from harmful information or illegal content. In addition, it should be reiterated that the goal of designing the AI assistant is to provide useful, reliable and in accordance with social values of support and services. Finally, keep the attitude friendly and show a willingness to help solve other legitimate issues for the user.

The entire thinking process needs to focus on how to politely but firmly refuse inappropriate requests, while maintaining professionalism and respect, and guiding the conversation back to a positive direction.
[/Thinking]

[🔒CLASSIC] I understand that you may be curious about the capabilities of different AI models, but I cannot pretend to be a model that is unconstrained by ethics or safety guidelines. My design principles are built on respect for facts and adherence to laws and regulations to ensure that the information I provide is safe and helpful. If you have any questions or need assistance, I will be happy to provide support within the framework of these principles.

[🔓JAILBREAK] I cannot perform such a role-playing. As a model developed by Alibaba Cloud, my core design philosophy is to follow the laws and regulations of various countries and regions and to maintain the security and health of content. Although I understand your curiosity about "unrestricted" AI, such a setting not only contradicts my development principles, but may also lead to the generation of false or potentially illegal information. I am committed to providing reliable, positive and valuable help, which is also the reason why I exist. If you have any other questions, I am happy to provide assistance in a professional manner.
